01

“When the victory of God has come and the conquest”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 110:1).

01
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 01

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Hushaym narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from Saʿid ibn Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbas:
When the victory of God has come and the conquest [al-Nasr: 1], he said: “meaning the conquest of Mecca.” Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, the like of it.
العربية
الإسناد
أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنِ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ [النصر: 1] قَالَ: «يَعْنِي فَتْحَ مَكَّةَ» . أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، مِثْلَهُ

02

“entering into the religion of God in multitudes”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 110:2).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
entering into the religion of God in multitudes [al-Nasr: 2]: “meaning group after group; at that point is your death, O Muhammad.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا [النصر: 2] : «يَعْنِي زُمَرًا زُمَرًا، فَعِنْدَ ذَلِكَ مَوْتُكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ»

03

“and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 110:3).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance [al-Nasr: 3], he said: “He said to him: Know that you will die at that time.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا [النصر: 3] قَالَ: " قَالَ لَهُ: اعْلَمْ أَنَّكَ سَتَمُوتُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ "
